reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team: "Thanks, Pree, corrected: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23."

One thing to know: her earlier "Dock 23" message and my thread reply confirming it are still in #central-team unchanged. Anyone who reads those without the correction thread could still pick up the wrong site. She said no action was needed, so I haven't changed or followed up on either one.
